description: **Available Immediately** **Fully Furnished** Beautiful three bedroom one bath semi detached, consisting of approx 89sqm of accommodation with a garden. Accommodation at entrance level consists of hall, living room to the  front, large open kitchen dining area to the rear with a breakfast bar and dining area, and fully fitted modern kitchen with fridge, freezer, dishwasher, washing machine, oven and hob, and with double doors out to the large garden to the rear with patio area, the rest is done out in lawn. Upstairs there are three bedrooms, two double and one single, and main bathroom with electric shower. To the front is off-street parking. Wooden floors throughout.
